item: Field data files at most 200 KB; scripts join numbered pieces
summary: Maintainer 2026-11-15: the loop limits itself to 200 KB files. FIELD_PART_BYTES and the source-samples cap are 200 KB (text cut 100 KB, reserve 20 KB); card_quality_report and propose_source_additions take any numbered piece or the folder, join a complete set in memory and name the missing pieces of an incomplete one.
